🧾 Taxation
MI SB 0301 — Michigan Businesses Get New Tax Credit for Employee Organ Donations

Michigan employers can now claim a tax credit for paying employees’ time off to donate organs, up to $42,240 per single return and $84,480 per joint return. This change, added to Michigan’s corporate income tax rules, adjusts how income is calculated for businesses and their employees.

July 3, 2026: Given Immediate Effect.
